data_fields.name: prod_mult
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.15 progress per work over work needed

data_fields.name: work_per_skill_point
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.02 times efficiency times skill times speed times boost

data_fields.name: recipe_cost
data_fields.donor_constant: workshop override, else item crafting cost

data_fields.name: min_skill
data_fields.donor_constant: minimum attribute for the cost resource, from workshop info

data_fields.name: refund_before_progress
data_fields.donor_constant: full cost if progress is 0, else 0

best_idea: A crafting queue that books the cost as debt when an item is queued, pays when the stock covers it, refunds only a paid item that has made no progress, and gives each work tick to the first ready item in queue order.
decision_why: Keep the queued, paid, in-progress and done states and the refund-before-progress rule for a server-side craft queue, but make the queued cost a real hold in the one ledger; the donor debt is only a claim that other spenders ignore, and its separate debt tables are a second ledger we reject.
acceptance: A server test with 10 gold in stock queues a 10-gold craft, asserts a separate 10-gold spend is refused while queued, asserts unqueue before progress returns exactly 10 gold, and asserts unqueue after progress returns 0.
